exportName: Aviator BrewOps Kegs and Cases for Sale

source.screen: Inventory > Product Inventory > Cooler Inventory Totals; Sales > Kegs for Sale
source.includedRecords: Finished-goods inventory records where status is Available and package category is keg or can.
source.excludedFields: Internal lot numbers, locations, batches, notes, credentials, and non-keg or non-can product inventory are intentionally excluded.

websiteImport.codexPrompt: In the aviatorbrew.com website project, replace public/data/kegs-for-sale.json with the attached BrewOps kegs-for-sale.json snapshot and update https://aviatorbrew.com/kegs to read its top-level items array. Render one product for each item where status is Available and forSale is true. Show sixthBblKegs with sixthBblPrice; fiftyLKegs with fiftyLPrice; 12 oz cases with case12ozPrice; 12 oz 4-packs with fourPack12ozPrice when has12ozFourPack is true; 12 oz 6-packs with sixPack12ozPrice when has12ozSixPack is true; 16 oz cases with case16ozPrice; and 16 oz 4-packs with fourPack16ozPrice when has16ozFourPack is true. Preserve the package flags, timestamps, quantityNote, and backfillPickupNote. A zero price means not configured. A configured package with zero quantity is sold out; a false configuration flag means it is not offered. Cases, packs, loose cans, and total cans are alternate views of the same inventory and must not be added together. Replace the prior snapshot; do not merge exports.
displayRules: Pair every package quantity with the priceField specified in packagePriceMap.
Use twelveOzPackFormat and the has12ozFourPack, has12ozSixPack, and has16ozFourPack flags to distinguish not offered from sold out.
Treat a price of 0 as not configured; do not display it as a free product.
Case, pack, loose-can, and total-can quantities are alternate views of the same cans and must not be added together.
Replace the previous JSON snapshot instead of merging snapshots.

quantityNote: Case counts, retail-pack counts, and total can counts are alternative views of the same available cans. Do not add them together.
backfillPickupNote: Sixtels backfilled from 50 L kegs must be picked up Monday–Friday, 8:30 AM–5:00 PM.
